title: GR180 version E generator cooling system + thermal network (steady / transient / control)

glycol.name: MEG 35 % vol (inhibited, e.g. Clariant Antifrogen N / BASF Glysantin G48)

dry_cooler.spec: dry cooler, 1 x EC axial fan d450-500 (2000 m3/h, 150 W), Cu tube / Al fin coil 2 rows ~0.6 m2 face, UA >= 450 W/K at full fan, MEG 35 %, dp <= 30 kPa at 30 L/min; candidates Guentner (DE) GDF / GFH compact, LU-VE (IT) EHL, Thermokey (IT), Kelvion (DE)
dry_cooler.margin: at 45 C ambient the cooler rejects 150 % of the generator heat with the fan at 88 %

pump.spec: wet-rotor circulator with ECM + 0-10 V speed, e.g. Grundfos MAGNA3 25-120 (DK) / Wilo Stratos MAXO 25/0.5-12 (DE); flow switch + vortex flow meter (Huba Control 210 CH / SIKA VVX DE)

structure: L1 coolant supply temperature: PT100 TT-G03 after the 3-way valve -> PI (kp 0.25 /K, Ti 60 s) -> split range: 0-1 = 3-way mixing valve (bypass -> cooler), 1-2 = dry-cooler EC fan 15 -> 100 %; pump at constant 30 L/min (ECM, flow meter FT-G01)
L2 rotor temperature: IR pyrometer TT-R01/02 on the CFRP sleeve ends + EMF observer (V_dc, I_dc, speed -> E -> Br -> T_magnet) -> PI (Ti 300 s) -> blower VFD 35-100 %; SP 85 C

L3 winding temperature floor (part load): coolant SP = 55 + 13 x (1 - (P / 335 kW)^2) C (feed-forward from the AFE power) + slow PI trim (Ti 1200 s, +/-5 K) on the max slot PT100 towards 82 C -> the winding stays near its full-load temperature at every load (less thermal cycling of the VPI / Litz)
interlocks: start permissive = glycol flow OK + blower running + T_supply > 20 C (heater 2 kW in the loop for cold starts / anti-condensation) ; blower stays on 15 min after stop
control.tuning: PI gains tested in the transient model (no overshoot > 1 K on the supply, rotor settles in ~30 min)

protection.note: class H 180 C; full-load value ~83 C
CFRP high-Tg epoxy (Tg >= 190 C) and magnet adhesive limit; Sm2Co17 itself is good to 300 C

protection.trip: < 15 L/min for 10 s -> unload to 40 % then trip at winding 155 C

protection.alarm: < 60 % of the speed-dependent nominal (blower fault) or filter dp > 200 Pa
protection.trip: rotor trip via the IR / EMF signal

protection.signal: glycol expansion-tank level LS-G01 + leak-off drain float switch LS-G02 (between the double O-rings, pod bottom)
vibration (2 accelerometers on the end bells)
insulation (online IMD on the IT DC link)

sensors: 6 x PT100 slot (flat 3 x 10 mm, between the layers at mid-stack, 2 per phase, 3-wire, class A)
4 x PT100 end winding (2 per end, at the coil noses, bonded + tied before VPI)
2 x PT100 bearing outer ring (M8 x 1 probe in the cartridge, 1.5 mm wall)
4 x PT100 glycol (pod in / out, supply after the valve, return)
2 x PT100 cooling air (blower outlet, generator outlet)
2 x IR pyrometer 8-14 um on the sleeve ends (Optris CSmicro LT (DE) / Calex PyroMini (UK)) through the end-bell ports
glycol vortex flow meter + flow switch
2 x accelerometers 100 mV/g on the end bells
2 x speed / phase pickups on the front speed wheel
